Subject: MAP launch — scheduling, attendee roster & join details

Hi Susan / Tom,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — excited to get the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) kickoff on the calendar so we can align stakeholders and lock the evaluation timeline. Proposed details below — please confirm availability and primary attendees from your side.

Proposed kickoff: August 26, 2026 — 10:00–11:00 AM PT (60 minutes)
Agenda (draft):
- 10:00 – 10:10: Introductions & success criteria (Redwood / NovaViz)
- 10:10 – 10:25: MAP timeline and milestones (close target: Oct 15)
- 10:25 – 10:40: Evaluation plan & sample dataset scope
- 10:40 – 10:55: Roles, owner commitments, and escalation path
- 10:55 – 11:00: Next steps and calendar action items

Internal owners from Redwood: Olga (AM, kickoff lead), Ben (technical owner — evals), Lauren (customer success lead).

Can you confirm:
1) Which NovaViz stakeholders should attend the kickoff (names + emails)?
2) Any conflicts with the proposed time/day?
3) Any items to add to the agenda (security/compliance deep-dive, procurement touchpoints, etc.)?

I've attached a short agenda draft and our kickoff slide deck for context. I'll send a calendar invite once we confirm attendees.

Attachments: MAP-Agenda-draft-v1.pdf (1 page), redwood-kickoff-slide-deck.pptx (20 slides)

Thanks — looking forward to a short, focused kickoff to get MAP owners aligned.

— Olga
